title: Head – Brand Marketing
description:
**Company Description**  

AbhiBus is a leading online bus\-ticketing platform that aggregates ticket inventory from over 4,000 bus operators \- including major State Road Transport Corporations (SRTCs), covering more than 3\.5 lakh (350,000\+) routes across India. The AbhiBus website and apps allow users to check amenities provided by bus operators, compare booking fares, check bus timings in the searched route, live tracking of the bus before arrival, cancellation protection options and other facilities. It is the official ticketing partner for several state road transport corporation bus tickets and IRCTC bus bookings.


AbhiBus is owned and operated by ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited), India’s leading OTA for the Next Billion Users. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in FY25, ixigo offers AI\-powered train, flight, bus, and hotel bookings through its platforms \- ixigo, ConfirmTkt, and AbhiBus.

 **Job Description**  

We are looking for a Head – Brand Marketing to lead and redefine how India books and experiences bus travel through AbhiBus. In this role, you will blend data\-driven performance with emotive storytelling to scale the AbhiBus brand, strengthen market leadership in the online bus ticketing space, and own the end\-to\-end marketing journey for the modern bus traveler. You will be the brand custodian for AbhiBus—ensuring it is not just a transactional booking platform but a trusted companion for every bus journey across India.  



**Key Responsibilities**  

  

**1\. Brand Stewardship \& Narrative**  

* Architect AbhiBus’s brand positioning, visual identity, and voice to resonate across


diverse traveler segments and regional markets.  

* Ensure AbhiBus is perceived not as a commoditized booking tool, but as a premium,


reliable, and traveler\-first brand throughout the booking and travel journey.  

  

**2\. Integrated Multi\-Channel Growth**  

* Orchestrate high\-impact, 360\-degree marketing campaigns spanning Performance,


Social, PR, and Influencer channels tailored to the bus travel audience.  

* Move beyond transactional marketing to build a cohesive brand ecosystem that drives


top\-of\-funnel awareness and converts high\-intent travelers into confirmed bus bookings.  

  

**3\. Data\-Driven Performance \& LTV Optimisation**  

* Own the marketing tech stack and analytical framework to measure real\-time ROI across


all brand and performance channels.  

* Optimise the balance between Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and Customer Lifetime


Value (CLV), leveraging first\-party data and CRM tools to predict travel patterns and  

drive repeat bookings in a highly competitive, low\-loyalty category.**4\. GTM \& Product Innovation Strategy**  

* Partner with Product and Engineering to lead Go\-To\-Market (GTM) strategies for new


features such as booking technology enhancements, fintech integrations, ancillary  

services, and route\-level innovations.  

* Translate technical product updates into compelling consumer benefits that improve the


user experience and drive app adoption for AbhiBus.**5\. Strategic Partnerships \& Ecosystem Growth**  

* Identify and negotiate high\-leverage partnerships with bus operators, state transport


corporations, payment platforms, travel aggregators, and regional influencers.  

* Build alliances that act as force multipliers for the AbhiBus brand—expanding reach into


new demographics, routes, and markets, and creating exclusive value for our customers.  

  

**6\. Competitive Intelligence \& Trend Forecasting**  

* Serve as the internal expert on the online bus ticketing and broader surface\-transport


landscape, including competitive OTA platforms and emerging mobility players.  

* Synthesise market research and competitor moves to proactively pivot


strategies—anticipating trends such as tier\-2/3 city demand, sustainable bus travel,  

route\-specific dynamic pricing, and AI\-driven trip planning.  

  

**7\. Commercial Leadership \& P\&L Accountability**  

* Lead, mentor, and scale a high\-performing brand marketing team for the Bus business


unit.  

* Maintain P\&L accountability, aligning the marketing budget with AbhiBus’s broader


commercial goals and ensuring every rupee spent is an investment in scalable,  

sustainable growth. **Qualifications*** 10\+ years of marketing experience with 4\+ years in a senior leadership role (Senior


Manager / Head level) within high\-growth B2C travel, consumer tech, or e\-commerce  

companies.  

* Proven track record in FMCG, D2C, travel, hospitality, OTAs, or online marketplaces,


with deep understanding of seasonal demand cycles and regional market dynamics in  

India.  

* Expert\-level command of CAC/LTV modelling, multi\-touch attribution, and modern


MarTech stacks (CDPs, CRMs, GA4, and equivalent tools).  

* Demonstrated ability to marry high\-velocity performance marketing with emotive,


world\-class brand storytelling.  

* Experience recruiting, mentoring, and leading high\-performance, cross\-functional


marketing teams.  

* Strong P\&L management skills with the ability to align marketing output with broader


commercial and leadership\-level goals.  

* Understanding of the Indian bus travel market, regional language nuances, and tier\-2/3


city consumer behaviour is a strong plus. **Additional Information** **Nice\-to\-Have**  

* Experience working in or with online travel aggregators (OTAs) focused on bus or


surface transport.  

* Familiarity with vernacular and regional marketing strategies for Indian audiences.
* Prior exposure to fintech\-integrated or super\-app ecosystems within travel.


  

**Why AbhiBus?**  

* Lead the brand for one of India’s leading online bus ticketing platforms with a massive,


growing user base.  

* Shape how millions of Indians discover, book, and experience bus travel.

country’s most exciting travel categories.

India.

title: Sales & Marketing Operations Executive
description:
**Sales \& Marketing Operations Executive**
===========================================


**Address:** Somajiguda, Hyd


**Role Purpose**
----------------


To manage the backend engine of sales and marketing by ensuring enquiry tracking, quotation preparation, customer follow\-ups, documentation, coordination with internal departments, agency coordination, order\-status communication, and customer experience follow\-through.


This is not a hardcore marketing strategy role. This is an execution, coordination, follow\-up, CRM, and documentation role.


**Ideal Candidate**
-------------------


* **Experience:** 2–5 years
* **Qualification:** Graduate
* **Background:** Sales coordination, customer support, back\-office sales, CRM, order processing, commercial coordination, or operations support
* **Skills:** Excellent follow\-up, Excel/CRM discipline, email writing, coordination, documentation, and ownership
* **Age:** Flexible. Do not restrict unnecessarily to 28–35 unless there is a strong reason.
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **A. Enquiry \& Lead Coordination**


* Maintain a live enquiry tracker with source, customer name, requirement, status, next follow\-up date, quotation status, expected order value, and responsible sales person.
* Send brochures, data sheets, company profiles, product details, catalogues, and introductory emailers to prospects as per approved templates.
* Maintain a proper follow\-up sequence for every enquiry so that no lead is forgotten.
* Coordinate with the sales team to understand whether the enquiry is hot, warm, cold, closed, lost, or needs senior intervention.

### **B. Quotation \& Sales Documentation**


* Prepare and send quotations based on approved pricing, formats, terms, and inputs from the sales/commercial team.
* Prepare proforma invoices wherever required.
* Check customer purchase orders against company sales policy, approved price, delivery terms, payment terms, taxes, freight, and other commercial conditions.
* Escalate any mismatch in PO terms to the senior sales/commercial team before order processing.
* Maintain records of quotations sent, revised quotes, approvals, purchase orders, proforma invoices, and order confirmations.

### **C. Customer Follow\-Up / Keeping in Touch (KIT) System**


* Follow up with customers for pending quotations, expected order confirmation, advance payment, dispatch clearance, inspection dates, and documentation.
* Use a defined KIT strategy , Keep In Touch sequence , for structured customer communication.
* Send polite reminder emails, WhatsApp messages, and call follow\-ups as per approved scripts.
* Escalate delayed or high\-value follow\-ups to the relevant salesperson or senior manager.
* Ensure customers receive timely updates without depending only on sales representatives.

### **D. Sales Backend \& Commercial Coordination**


* Coordinate with sales representatives for customer updates, pending documents, order status, and follow\-up remarks.
* Coordinate with the commercial department for order processing, production plan review, dispatch clearance, invoices, and payment documents.
* Coordinate with the factory/production team for material readiness, inspection status, dispatch planning, and expected timelines.
* Coordinate with transporters for vehicle placement, LR details, dispatch acknowledgements, and delivery confirmation.
* Generate or coordinate sale invoices where applicable.

### **E. Customer Experience \& Completion Documentation**


* Send order completion reports to customers after supply.
* Obtain completion certificates from customers for company records.
* Track customer complaints, delays, missing documents, delayed dispatches, and unresolved issues.
* Maintain a customer experience tracker showing whether the customer had a smooth, delayed, problematic, or escalated experience.
* Share recurring customer issues with management for process improvement.

### **F. Agency \& Marketing Collateral Coordination**


* Coordinate with marketing agencies/freelancers for brochures, datasheets, catalogues, emailers, LinkedIn creatives, and other collaterals.
* Collect inputs from sales/product/management and convert them into clear agency briefs.
* Maintain updated folders of final approved marketing material.
* Ensure the sales team has access to the latest brochures, presentations, company profile, product sheets, and email templates.
* Track agency deliverables, deadlines, approvals, and revisions.

### **G. Records, CRM \& MIS**


* Maintain customer\-wise files containing enquiry history, quotations, PO, PI, correspondence, dispatch details, invoices, payment status, completion certificate, and complaints.
* Update CRM/Excel/ERP daily.
* Prepare weekly MIS on enquiries, quotes sent, follow\-ups due, orders received, pending advances, dispatches, completion certificates pending, and payments pending.
* Share ageing reports for pending quotations, pending customer approvals, pending payments, and pending documents.
**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
-------------------------------------


* Number of enquiries entered and tracked weekly


* Number of quotations prepared and sent


* Quotation\-to\-order follow\-up completion rate


* Number of overdue follow\-ups


* Average quotation turnaround time


* Number of completion certificates collected


* Pending payment follow\-up ageing


* Number of customer documents pending


* Agency deliverables completed on time


* CRM/Excel/ERP update accuracy percentage


**Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs) \& Measurement**
--------------------------------------------------


### **Enquiry tracking discipline**


**Measurement:** 100% of enquiries entered within 24 hours


### **Quotation turnaround**


**Measurement:** Standard quotes sent within agreed TAT


### **Follow\-up discipline**


**Measurement:** No follow\-up overdue beyond 48 hours


### **Documentation accuracy**


**Measurement:** PO/PI/quotation errors below defined tolerance

**Role Overview**


Cambridge Technology is seeking an experienced Email Marketing \& Campaign Manager to plan, manage, and execute email campaigns across all Cambridge brands, products, and target audiences. This contractor will own the complete campaign lifecycle from campaign strategy, audience selection, and scheduling through automation, deployment, optimization, and performance reporting.


The role requires a strong combination of strategic thinking and hands\-on campaign management. The selected candidate will work with internal marketing, content, design, product, sales, and technology teams to deliver relevant, timely, and compliant email communications that strengthen engagement, support lead generation, and contribute to business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and manage the email marketing strategy and campaign calendar across all Cambridge brands, products, and business priorities.
* Manage end\-to\-end execution of newsletters, product promotions, lead\-nurturing programs, event campaigns, cold\-outreach campaigns, customer communications, and re\-engagement campaigns.
* Define campaign objectives, target audiences, segmentation criteria, messaging requirements, schedules, workflows, and calls to action.
* Build, configure, test, schedule, and deploy email campaigns using relevant email marketing and marketing automation platforms.
* Create automated workflows, nurture sequences, drip campaigns, lead\-scoring logic, triggers, and lifecycle\-based communication programs.
* Manage contact segmentation, suppression lists, subscription preferences, consent records, data quality, duplicate records, and campaign eligibility rules.
* Conduct A/B and multivariate testing across subject lines, sender names, content, calls to action, layouts, timing, and audience segments.
* Monitor campaign performance, analyze results, identify improvement opportunities, and provide clear recommendations and reports to internal stakeholders.
* Manage email deliverability by monitoring sender reputation, bounce rates, spam complaints, domain authentication, inbox placement, and engagement quality.
* Ensure campaigns comply with applicable email marketing and data privacy requirements, including CAN\-SPAM, GDPR, consent management, and unsubscribe regulations.
* Maintain campaign documentation, naming conventions, templates, quality\-control checklists, approval processes, and reporting standards.
* Stay current with changes in email marketing technology, automation practices, privacy regulations, deliverability standards, and AI\-enabled campaign optimization.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5–8 years of hands\-on experience in email marketing, campaign management, marketing automation, or a related digital marketing role.
* Demonstrated experience managing the complete lifecycle of B2B email campaigns across multiple brands, products, audiences, or markets.
* Strong knowledge of campaign planning, audience segmentation, personalization, marketing automation, lead nurturing, and customer lifecycle communications.
* Hands\-on experience building, testing, deploying, and optimizing campaigns using leading email marketing and automation platforms.
* Strong understanding of email deliverability, sender reputation, bounce management, spam prevention, domain authentication, and inbox\-placement practices.
* Working knowledge of SPF, DKIM, DMARC, subscription management, consent requirements, and applicable email marketing regulations.
* Experience with A/B testing, campaign analytics, attribution, reporting, and translating performance data into actionable recommendations.
* Strong project management, attention to detail, problem\-solving, and internal stakeholder communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, audience segments, and business priorities simultaneously.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

The successful candidate should have hands\-on experience with leading email marketing, CRM, automation, analytics, and campaign\-quality platforms, including several of the following:

* Email marketing and automation: HubSpot, Mailchimp, Adobe Marketo Engage, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce Account Engagement, Klaviyo, Brevo, or comparable platforms.
* Lead generation and sales engagement: Apollo.io, Outreach, Salesloft, or similar platforms.

* Analytics and reporting: Google Analytics 4, Looker Studio, native campaign\-reporting tools, and spreadsheet\-based reporting.
* Email testing and quality assurance: Litmus, Email on Acid, or comparable email preview and testing tools.
* Deliverability and domain monitoring: Google Postmaster Tools, Microsoft SNDS, MXToolbox, and related reputation\-monitoring tools.
